problem: Native 16-slot memory bank can retain 12 learned relationships, but current call sites must provide the exact memory-slot address. Test whether the bank can select candidate memory from observed action effects without seeing task identity, while refusing to promote unverified guesses.
hypothesis: After at most 8 real public action observations on a re-encountered NKR-11 world, a read-only tokenless balanced-partition cue selector will provisionally recover the correct stored relation slot for >=10/12 already-exposed worlds with zero incorrect old-world predictions. It must preserve canonical prior bank bytes and may not certify any unknown-law slot.

model.interface: select(bank, public_cues) -> provisional slot or abstain and remaining matches; propose(bank,public_cues) -> next public context/action with deterministic balanced partition; immutable and no hidden task label or source oracle.
model.cues: Each item is exactly three typed binary/integer public fields [context:0..15, action:0|1, observed_consequence:0|1], no hidden world id/slot, no duplicated queried pair, max 8 public cues.
model.candidate_filter: Only stored slots whose explicitly learned NKR11 model public predictions agree with every provided result can remain. An unidentified prediction must not be treated as evidence for a match; retain unknown predictions conservatively. Empty evidence cannot qualify a single slot.
model.provisional_requirement: Exactly one surviving stored model and at least 4 real distinct public interventions, all predictions on observed cues identifiable; returned classification always PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_SLOT_MATCH, never task authenticated, scientific verified, model accepted or automatically admitted.
model.action_policy: From 32 possible (context,action) probes, choose unqueried probe maximizing min(known positive,known negative) across surviving memory models; ties lexicographic context,action. When only one candidate remains, choose unqueried confirmation context/action with greatest disagreement against the full other stored models (to challenge a premature match), then lex. If zero plausible candidates, abstain; no hidden oracle.
model.capacity: Read-only native checkpoint; max 16 slots, 8 distinct public probes per episode, no storage writes. Selector may not choose a hidden 'world identity' as action key.

source.originality: Reuses NKR11 exposed deterministic engineering source; independent protected science first-use count 0
source.law_type: 12 already learned source-specific 10-feature GF2 action/context relations, each already warm-and-repaired in NKR12 native bank; NKR11 deterministic action simulator solely in evaluator.
source.training: Use exactly existing 32 public warm and 16 public postchange repair actions per stored world. No training updates during routing; source-coded identities never in model API.
source.retrieval: 12 target episodes; each source world runs publicly chosen real do(context,action) for each policy up to 8 queries; score correct provisional slot or abstention, cost actual action count, confident wrong. No new oracle information outside public result to model.
source.negative: Four nonresident conjunction action-effect worlds with public effects parity((context&1<<(world%4))) XOR (action AND int((context & mask)==mask)) for fixed masks [3,5,6,9]. These are fixtures reused in theme from separately qualified NKR12 out-of-family falsification and cannot be labeled scientific new sources. Count provisional false matches; never treat as verified. Empty, duplicate, adversarial corrupted cue and same-bank no member cases must fail-closed.
source.source_cohorts: No protected first-use, no hidden source / validation outcomes promoted.

controls.strong: Independent fully informed exact enumeration over the 12 original unmodified NKR11 stored models with the same public feedback and same <=8-action budget, choosing the same min-balanced split and lex tiebreak; should tie native router. No algorithmic superiority claim.
controls.fixed: First eight context/action pairs in ascending order. Same budget but no information-seeking.
controls.random: SHA256 ASCII 'CUE01|fixed-random-policy|context|action' sorted ascending over all 32 pairs, same order for every world; no world ID in RNG.
controls.negative: No cues, wrong/corrupt cue, ambiguous identical predictions, unknown source-law cases; abstentions correct safety response and counted separately.
controls.cost: Measure per-policy action count and whole experiment wall, canonical bank checkpoint size. No externally grounded energy/whole model efficiency claims.

gates.stop: Single frozen source-only development screen after prereg and implementation/tests are committed. If any required gate fails, DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE. No postresult threshold/seed/source tuning.

allowed_paths: three existing derived .ice/code-atlas.* after independent qualification
